name: bone
description: Bone of the skeleton. Goes inside a skeleton (the root bones) or inside another bone of the same skeleton; never at the root or in a group. Starts at x/y (relative to its parent bone or, if it is a root bone, to the skeleton) and points in the direction of rotation with length length (rotation 0 = to the right, 90 = downward). Bones only have bones as children: the skeleton's drawing is attached to them with the bone property of each object. These values are the setup (the rest pose); poses are used to move the character.
help: Bone of the skeleton. Lives inside a skeleton (root bones) or another bone of the same skeleton; drawings bind to it with "bone".

x.help: Origin of the bone (its joint), relative to the parent bone, or to the skeleton for a root bone.
x.description: Origin of the bone (its joint), relative to the parent bone (or to the skeleton, if it is a root bone).

y.help: Origin of the bone, relative to the parent bone or the skeleton (grows downward).
y.description: Origin of the bone, relative to the parent bone or the skeleton (grows downward).

rotation.help: Direction of the bone in degrees, relative to its parent; positive = clockwise.
rotation.description: Direction of the bone in degrees, relative to the parent (bone or skeleton); positive = clockwise.

scaleX.help: Scale along the bone; its children and what is bound to it inherit it.
scaleX.description: Scale along the bone; inherited by its children and by what is bound to it.

length.help: Length of the bone in px.
length.description: Length of the bone in px. Used to display it and to chain the next bone at its tip.

independentAngle.help: Follows the parent position but not its rotation or scale (useful for a head or hands that stay level).
independentAngle.description: If true, it follows the parent's position but not its rotation or scale (useful for a head or hands that keep their orientation).

minAngle.help: Minimum rotation allowed in poses (degrees, same reference as rotation). Empty = no limit.
minAngle.description: Minimum rotation allowed in poses (degrees, same reference as rotation). null = no limit.

maxAngle.help: Maximum rotation allowed in poses. Empty = no limit.
maxAngle.description: Maximum rotation allowed in poses. null = no limit.
